name: env.observe
description: Capture a new environment observation at Runtime-owned sampling points.

name: knowledge.load
description: Read guidance for judging progress, choosing an action or recovering when a catalog entry addresses a missing method. The catalog is a directory, not loaded guidance. Reconsider relevant guidance when attempts make no useful progress. Returns newly requested body text and declared references; reuse delivered content. Knowledge supplies methods, not detection or distance measurements of the current scene; do not load every entry by default.

name.description: Exact enabled entry name from the knowledge catalog.

reference_paths.description: Optional paths from the entry's returned reference manifest.

name: runtime.report_blocked
description: Stop the instruction as incomplete when evidence, capabilities or safety prevent meaningful progress. A target not yet visible is not itself a blocker if a safe useful next step exists. Do not require a fixed number of attempts or exhaust all tools before stopping. Returns the accepted terminal state or rejection feedback. Runtime handles final stabilization and cleanup.

reason.description: Concise explanation of the task outcome.

evidence_refs.description: Current-instruction observation or returned environmental result references; plan and knowledge references are not environmental evidence.

suggested_user_action.description: Optional action the user can take to resolve the blocker.

name: runtime.report_completed
description: Report the original instruction completed. Compare observed results with all original requirements, not just the last action, a detected candidate or plan status. Cite environmental evidence. Returns the accepted terminal state or rejection feedback. Runtime handles final stabilization and cleanup.

reason.description: Concise explanation of the task outcome.

evidence_refs.description: Current-instruction observation or returned environmental result references; plan and knowledge references are not environmental evidence.

name: runtime.update_plan
description: Create or revise a task list. For complex tasks, use this as the first call: ordered requirements, search followed by another goal, route and final-position obligations, or constraints retained across observations benefit from a plan. A simple single immediate goal can act directly. Keep near-term work concrete and unseen later work broad. Preserve stable IDs and completed work; cancel obsolete steps. Update when observed progress or new evidence changes the plan, not after every action. Returns the saved plan and revision; it never executes flight or supplies environmental completion evidence.

explanation.description: Why this plan or evidence-based revision is needed.

steps.description: Ordered task steps with persistent identities.
Reach the requested position relative to it

name: skill.visual_grounding.measure_visible_depth
description: Supplement direct visual reasoning only when a decision-relevant target cannot be reliably localized or distinguished, or its measured distance is necessary. Do not delegate general scene understanding or already clear visibility/location to this detector. Use include_distance=false for unresolved localization and true for decision-critical measurement. Confirm candidate identity from the annotated evidence; distance is camera-to-visible-surface depth, not horizontal or target-center distance.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id shown on the CURRENT image label.

query.description: Concise description of a decision-relevant target requiring localization or measurement, not a general scene inventory.

include_distance.description: Enable only for a measured-distance request, a nearby metric threshold affecting action, or a quantitative completion claim; a numeric mention alone does not require measurement.

name: uav.ascend
description: Ascend using the configured internal vertical-motion primitive.

name: uav.connect
description: Connect the vehicle control interface during Runtime preflight.

name: uav.descend
description: Descend using the configured internal vertical-motion primitive.

name: uav.get_frames
description: Capture camera frames through the configured simulator backend.

name: uav.get_pose
description: Read vehicle pose for Runtime observation and motion measurement.

name: uav.hover
description: Hold the vehicle for Runtime stabilization, safety intervention or cleanup.

name: uav.land
description: Land the vehicle during caller-selected shutdown.

name: uav.move_body
description: Translate in the vehicle's current body frame when the task requires changing position. Choose motion from available route or target evidence. Translation is not a heading-only correction or a completion report. Runtime may limit velocity; inspect actual execution and the post-batch observation.

vx.description: Positive moves forward; negative moves backward.

vy.description: Positive moves right; negative moves left.

vz.description: Positive moves up; negative moves down.

name: uav.set_pose
description: Set an episode's initial pose before task observations.

name: uav.takeoff
description: Take off when the scene requires flight initialization.

name: uav.turn_relative
description: Change vehicle heading to inspect a view or face a cue. Turning changes bearing, not physical passage or distance to a target. Results report execution; a new observation follows the batch.

yaw_deg.description: Signed relative yaw in degrees: negative turns left; positive turns right.
